name: What is the typical timeline for finish carpentry in a custom renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for finish carpentry in a custom renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for finish carpentry is integrated within the broader schedule of a comprehensive renovation. It typically occurs in the later stages, after rough construction, drywall installation, and painting are largely complete, but before final flooring installation and fixture placement. The duration varies based on the scope, such as the complexity of trim profiles, the amount of custom built-ins, and the overall size of the project. As part of our managed process, AKN Design Group provides a transparent project schedule, clearly outlining when finish carpentry will take place to ensure timely completion within the overall renovation timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry occurs in the later stages of a renovation, after rough construction, drywall, and painting, with timelines varying based on scope.
